scope: RPU re-fit (protocol-rpu-refit-20261112.json incl. amendments 1-4): untouched BL plus re-fitted single-layer mapping curves, scored against the FEL composition with the frozen four-model operators; no encode. F+ = Fp_safe (the only arm written to RPUs). Device checks: macOS AVFoundation display path only.

gross.method: P8.1 MP4s (MP4Box dvp=8.hdr10) of the same encoded frames with three RPU sets; AVPlayerLayer rendered offscreen by CARenderer into an rgba16Float texture (extended linear BT.2020, EDR on); mean linear R/G/B of the central region at t=2.00 s
gross.AVAssetReader_and_AVPlayerItemVideoOutpu: identical for every RPU set (decode output carries DolbyVisionRPUData as an attachment; reshaping is not applied there)
gross.note: the refit row of the first run used the superseded Fp_poly curves and is dropped

flat_patch.method: dv_patch_clips.sh with the Michael5400 Fp_safe readback: A = 48 flat patches at codes c with the F+ RPU, B = codes round(f(c)/4) with the identity RPU, C = codes c with the identity RPU; CARenderer dumps, central half of each patch

device_check_macos.conclusion: macOS applies a non-identity 8.1 luma polynomial and chroma MMR in the display path, close to libplacebo semantics (A matches B, not C); not bit-exact.

device_check_android: Not observed. Google TV Streamer: video plane black to screencap/screenrecord, HDR10-only monitor. Pixels: no Dolby Vision display support. Lenovo TB322FC (Dolby Vision decoder, screencap sees video) pending.
